gaps.explanation: 'The courage he showed' — the relative clause makes it definite.

gaps.sentence: We reached ___ agreement after hours of negotiation.
gaps.explanation: 'Reach an agreement' — 'agreement' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: She has ___ excellent command of Japanese.
gaps.explanation: 'Have an excellent command of' — 'excellent' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: They elected her ___ chairperson for a second term.
gaps.explanation: After 'elect/appoint', roles take no article: elected her chairperson.

gaps.sentence: They sailed across ___ Mediterranean last summer.
gaps.explanation: Seas and oceans take 'the': the Mediterranean.

gaps.sentence: I saw ___ film last night, and the film was about mountain climbers.
gaps.hint: first mention of one of many
gaps.explanation: First mention of a countable noun takes 'a'; the second mention becomes 'the' (already written out here).

gaps.sentence: We bought ___ antique mirror at the flea market.
gaps.explanation: 'An antique mirror' — 'antique' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: We had ___ lunch at a bistro near the cathedral.
gaps.explanation: Names of meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner) take no article when used generally.
